description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Aurora develops self-driving technology intended to make mobility and logistics safer, more efficient, and more accessible. The Software Engineer on the Performance Engineering Optimization team will build tooling, data pipelines, and processing systems to analyze performance data, reduce onboard software latency, improve hardware utilization, and support optimization efforts across engineering domains.
Performance engineering specialist building vehicle and simulation data pipelines for optimization analysis

Responsibilities:
• Create and contribute to tooling that probes, collects & processes monumental amounts of performance data both on-vehicle & in-simulation
• Design, build, and maintain robust, cost-effective data pipelines and processing systems that ingest and transform data across sources into our warehouse, supporting downstream tools for performance visualization and analysis
• Collaborate cross functionally with engineers in various domains within Aurora, including Autonomy, Sensing, Vehicle Platform Infrastructure on optimization efforts

Requirements:
• C++ or Python programming and software design skills
• Knowledge of ETL pipelines
• Ability to apply statistical and ML methods for data analysis
• Experience and knowledge of Linux fundamentals
• BS or MS in Robotics, Computer Science or a related field with 1-3 years of professional experience

Preferred:
• Knowledge and interest in cloud storage, cloud based data pipelines
• Experience in data science and data engineering on cloud platforms
• Familiarity with Linux OS fundamentals and basic concepts of performance optimization for soft real-time systems
